$$(1 + 0.005)^{60} = 1.005^{60} \approx 1.34885015255$$

$$100 \times 1.34885015255 = 134.885015255$$

Next, calculate the denominator:
$$(1 + i)^n - 1 = 1.34885015255 - 1 = 0.34885015255$$

**2. Calculate the monthly payment (M):**
$$M = \frac{134.885015255}{0.34885015255}$$

$$M = \frac{100}{1 - (1.005)^{-60}}$$
$$(1.005)^{-60} \approx 0.74137220016$$
$$M = \frac{100}{1 - 0.74137220016}$$
$$M = \frac{100}{0.25862779984}$$
$$M \approx 386.248306$$

$386.248306 \approx 386.25$
